==Biography==

===Season 3===

Baek '''"Save"''' Young-jin joined [[NaJin Shield]] as their new mid laner on March 25, 2013. His first tournament with the team was [[OLYMPUS Champions Spring 2013]] where Shield made it to the quarterfinals but lost 3-1 to [[CJ Entus Frost]]. Soon after the tournament was over, Shield renamed to '''NaJin White Shield''' and Save began a transition to top lane when [[Expession]] was moved to [[NaJin Black Sword]]. [[HOT6iX Champions Summer 2013]] was his inaugural tournament in the top lane and Shield ended up in the quarterfinals. However, they met Frost again and were quickly dispatched 3-0.

===2014 Season===

Save and Shield began the new season at [[PANDORA.TV Champions Winter 2013-2014]]. Shield qualified for the semifinals but lost 3-1 to [[Samsung Galaxy Ozone]]. They also lost the third place match 3-1 to the [[KT Rolster Bullets]] to end in fourth place overall, their highest placing yet. They would continue their upward trend at [[HOT6iX Champions Spring 2014]] where they made their first final against [[Samsung Galaxy Blue]], but they were comfortably beaten 3-1. The final OGN of the year was [[HOT6iX Champions Summer 2014]] where Shield made the quarterfinals but lost 3-2 to the [[KT Rolster Arrows]]. The team earned enough circuit points to qualify for the [[2014 Season Korea Regional Finals]] as the third seed. Shield ran the entire guantlet, beating the Bullets, the Arrows, and [[SK Telecom T1 K]] while only dropping one game in the process to qualify for the [[2014 Season World Championship]] as the third seed from Korea. Shield was placed in a group with [[Cloud9]], [[Alliance]], and [[KaBuM! e-Sports]]. They placed first after winning a tie breaker against C9 and were placed against [[OMG]] in their quarterfinal matchup. Shield suffered crushing defeat at the hands of OMG, losing 3-0 after the latter decided to sub in [[Cloud (Hu Zhen-Wei)|Cloud]] as their support.

===2015 Season===

Save left Shield on December 1, 2014 to join [[Invictus Gaming]].<ref>[http://www.weibo.com/2099708877/ByOVjFwXt?from=page_1005052099708877_profile&wvr=6#_rnd1417434569902 Invictus Gaming's Weibo Post (Chinese)] ''weibo.com''</ref> Save only played three games with them during the [[2015 LPL/Spring/Regular Season|2015 LPL Spring Regular Season]] where IG ended in fifth place. IG placed third in the [[2015 LPL/Summer/Playoffs|2015 LPL Spring Playoffs]] but Save did not play any games for them during this time. Shortly afterwards, he was moved to IG's LSPL team, [[Young Glory]]. He played with them initially in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Summer Season|2015 Demacia Cup/Summer Season]]. Here, YG made it to the round of 16 but they lost 3-1 to [[Vici Gaming]]. In [[2015 LoL Secondary Pro League/Summer Playoffs|LSPL Summer 2015]], YG placed sixth with losses to [[Hyper Youth Gaming]] and [[2144 Danmu Gaming]] but they still qualified for the [[LPL/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|LPL 2016 Season Spring Promotion Tournament]]. YG lost in the first round 3-2 to [[Royal Never Give Up]].

===2016-17 Season===

Save left Young Glory in April of 2017 and joined Invictus Gaming in June as a substitute. He spent the majority of 2016 and 2017 as a sub. He did however play several games in the [[LPL/2016_Season/Summer_Season|2016 LPL Summer Season]] but only won a few against [[I May]] and [[Snake Esports]].
